product_tagline: Discover places through preferences, not ratings.
phase_zero_status: We are building the restaurant experience first, with hotels following before beta.
landing_lede: Compare places you actually know. GustiMei turns those choices into a private personal order and more meaningful suggestions—without reducing taste to stars.
landing_comparison_prompt: Overall, which restaurant did you prefer?
landing_choice_two: The lively table by the market
landing_tie: Tie or skip are always available
landing_principle_control_body: Pause, resume, tie, skip, or undo. Progress reflects real work, never pressure.
landing_principle_feedback_body: Each comparison helps form an understandable personal order; recommendations appear only when support is sufficient.
landing_principle_trust_body: Rankings and notes are private. Optional public reviews are separate and clearly labelled.
auth_sign_up_intro: Create an account, verify your email, then choose restaurants you have visited.
name: Name
name_help: Used only for your private account. It is never your public review name.
age_declaration: I confirm that I am at least 18 years old.
accept_terms: I accept the Terms of use.
disclosure_acknowledgement: I have read how my private preference comparisons contribute pseudonymously to recommendations.
privacy_presented: The Privacy Notice explains purposes, retention, rights, and contact details. It is presented for information, not consent.
check_email_body: If the address can receive a message, we sent a verification link. The link expires in one hour.
verification_sent: If the address belongs to an account needing verification, a new link has been sent.
auth_sign_in_intro: Sign in to continue your private ranking.
generic_auth_error: We could not complete that request. Check the details and try again.
verify_before_sign_in: Check your email and verify the address before signing in.
forgot_intro: Enter your email. We always show the same confirmation to protect account privacy.
reset_request_confirmation: If an account can use that address, a reset link has been sent. It expires in one hour.
password_reset_success: Your password was changed. Sign in again on your devices.
invalid_or_expired_link: This link is invalid, expired, or has already been used.
verification_success_body: Your address is verified. You can continue to Discover.
verification_error_body: The link may be invalid or expired. Request a new one from the sign-in page.
map_discover_intro: Explore the supported recommendation area, then move or search the map to recalculate the nearby order.
map_search_help: Search runs only when submitted and is limited to locations in Italy.
map_restaurants_loading: Loading restaurants in this map area…
map_restaurants_error: Restaurants could not be refreshed. Move the map to try again.
map_nearby_count: {count} ranked restaurants in this map area
map_nearby_empty: Move or zoom out the map to find supported restaurants.
map_supported_scope_help: The map shows every catalogue restaurant. This list contains only restaurants with recommendation data, ordered within the current map area.
personal_ranking_tied_position: Tied at position {position} in your private ranking
personal_ranking_unplaced: Visited, not placed in your ranking yet
top_recommendation_national: In your top 10% of recommendations across Italy
map_mark_visited_success: Marked as visited. Keep exploring whenever you like.
ranking_invitation_body: A few comparisons can place your recent visits. You can leave and return at any time.
recommendations_intro: A predicted order across supported restaurants, including places you have and have not visited.
personalized_order_body: This order compares your resolved preferences with compatible community rankings. It is a prediction, not a public score.
community_order_body: You have ranked {count} supported places. Rank more restaurants to unlock personalization; this order currently uses the regularized community prior.
insufficient_recommendation_body: Keep ranking visited restaurants. We will show an order once supported community preference evidence exists.
review_isolation_explanation: Public reviews, review volume, and private notes never affect this order.
recommendation_locality_help: Applied after the global order is predicted. Empty local results are not filled with places outside this scope.
recommendation_scope_empty: No supported results in this scope
recommendation_scope_empty_body: Expand the scope to see supported places from the same global predicted order.
reviews_manage_intro: Public reviews are optional and separate from rankings. A review never changes your order or recommendations.
coming_phase_four: Place selection is the next implementation phase.
settings_intro: Your account identity stays private. Create a public pseudonym only if you choose to publish a review.
pseudonym_help: 3–40 letters, numbers, spaces, apostrophes, periods, underscores, or hyphens. It can be changed once every 30 days; an old name remains reserved to you for 180 days.
pseudonym_saved: Your public pseudonym is ready for future reviews.
no_public_identity_body: That does not affect ranking or recommendations.
private_note_explanation: A note only you can see, to remember your experience and compare it later with experiences at other places. It is not a review and does not affect recommendations.
private_note_label: What would you like to remember?
private_note_save_help: Saved only when you choose Save. GustiMei does not autosave this field.
public_review_explanation: This text is public under your pseudonym. It is separate from your private ranking and notes, and it never affects recommendations.
declaration_used_service: I personally and actually used this service.
declaration_relevant: This review concerns that experience or relevant characteristics of the place.
declaration_not_incentivized: No discount, benefit, payment, promise, or other incentive produced this review.
service_date_help: Must be today or within the previous 30 Italian calendar days. Only month and year are public.
review_body_help: Share concrete, experience-based information or practical advice. Do not include private data or a ranking score.
notice_explanation: Explain the issue and identify relevant facts
notice_explanation_help: Use {minimum}–{maximum} characters so the report can be assessed.
owner_delegate_assertion: I am the place owner or an authorized delegate.
evidence_privacy_help: Evidence is not public or recommendation data. Access and deletion are audited.
evidence_file_help: PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, or plain text; maximum 5 MB.
evidence_optional_file_help: Optional. PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, or plain text; maximum 5 MB.
legal_draft_notice: Provisional local-development text. Legal approval is required before external beta.
validation_password_length: Password must contain at least 8 characters.
validation_acceptances: Confirm the age declaration, Terms, and preference-sharing disclosure to continue.
rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
my_ranking_intro: Your private order of visited restaurants. Recommendations and public reviews remain separate.
ranking_empty_body: Mark at least two restaurants as visited on the map, then update your ranking when convenient.
ranking_up_to_date: Your ranking is up to date
ranking_up_to_date_body: New visited restaurants will appear here when there is useful ranking work.
not_placed_yet_body: These visited restaurants do not have a position yet. They are not tied with one another.
rerank_entire_list_body: Rebuild the ordering with fresh comparisons. Visited places and private notes are kept.
selection_intro: Search by name and narrow by locality. Your selections form one private global restaurant list.
locality_filter_help: Optional city, municipality, province, or postal code. It filters this view, not your list identity.
search_empty_body: Try a shorter name, another locality, or remove the locality filter.
search_prompt: Search the Italian restaurant catalogue to add places you know.
remove_place_confirm: Remove this place? Its private personal note will also be deleted.
comment_deleted_with_place: Removing a place also permanently deletes its private personal note.
ranking_ready: You can start ordering your list
ranking_ready_body: Two places are enough. Adding more visited places can improve recommendation confidence.
ranking_not_ready: Add at least two places to start ordering them.
catalogue_attribution: Place data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under ODbL.
public_reviews_intro: Optional public experiences. They are not ratings, your private ranking, or recommendation scores.
review_management_empty: You have not published a review.
review_withdrawn: The review is no longer public.
review_unavailable: Review publication is not available yet
review_unavailable_body: An approved review policy and a verified account with a public pseudonym are required.
review_pseudonym_required_body: Create a public pseudonym before writing a review.
good_faith_declaration: I believe in good faith that the information and allegations in this notice are accurate and complete.
notice_submitted: Your report was received. Save the case link to follow its status.
notice_duplicate_reused: This report matches an active notice. The existing case was reused.
phase_five_session_ready: Your comparison session is saved and ready for the Phase 5 comparison experience.
edit_same_visit_help: Available only while the original service date remains inside the 30-day publication window. Publication and expiry dates do not change.
substitute_review_help: A later visit starts a new publication generation and preserves the restricted history of the previous one.
anonymous_notice: Use the narrow anonymous legal-notice branch. Owner/delegate priority and case access are unavailable unless you provide contact details.
review_verification_disclosure: The author made the required declarations. GustiMei has not independently verified the experience; this label does not permit fictitious reviews.
comparison_prompt: Overall, which restaurant did you prefer?
comparison_help: Choose either restaurant, mark them equal, or skip if you cannot compare them.
keyboard_shortcuts: Keyboard: Left/1, Right/2, T for tie, S to skip, U to undo.
session_superseded_body: Another ranking session is now active. Return to your visited restaurants to continue safely.
ranking_complete_body: Saved privately. Tied places share a position; unresolved places are shown separately.
unresolved_places_body: A skip left too little evidence to place these restaurants reliably. They remain visited and can be compared later.
ranking_publish_retry: Your comparisons are saved, but the ranked list still needs to be published.
optional_review_prompt: Would you like to write one optional public review?
optional_review_prompt_body: This is separate from your private ranking. You will enter a service date and declarations on the review page; dismissing it does not change your ranking.
resume_ranking_body: Your saved session has about {remaining} comparisons remaining.
repair_ranking_body: A focused comparison can repair the affected evidence without rebuilding the rest of your list.
rebuild_ranking_body: Ask all ordering questions again. Your visited places and private notes are preserved.
delete_ranking_confirm: Delete this restaurant list, its ranking history, and all associated private notes? Public reviews are not changed.
delete_ranking_body: This permanently deletes the list, comparison history, and private notes. Public reviews remain independent.
ranking_deleted: The restaurant list and its private notes were deleted.
remove_ranked_place_confirm: Remove this restaurant from the ranking? Its private note will be deleted; its public review will not change.
filtered_ranking_help: Positions are recalculated for this locality view. Your global ranking is unchanged.
case_access_recovery_intro: Enter the case reference and the notifier email used in the report. If they match, we will send a fresh link that expires after 7 days.
case_access_recovery_confirmation: If the case and email match, a fresh case link has been sent.
case_access_invalid: This notifier case link is invalid or expired.
notice_submitted_without_case_access: Your anonymous report was received. Because no contact email was provided, there is no case link to save.
